## [1.4.0](https://github.com/Jl4cTuk/morphe-patches/compare/v1.3.0...v1.4.0) (2026-08-26)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* block remaining RuStore analytics channels ([880b2f9](https://github.com/Jl4cTuk/morphe-patches/commit/880b2f9b4c803569b262ddc9ce550cfa4ddfd349))
* fully disable RuStore advertising tracking ([161a602](https://github.com/Jl4cTuk/morphe-patches/commit/161a60285f1eb0dc9108442a3cbabdb559712410))
* fully disable RuStore background scanning ([3a5c506](https://github.com/Jl4cTuk/morphe-patches/commit/3a5c50605c60a38592d6c274817e0754968a42ed))
* select RuStore secure-session compatibility by install mode ([0df233b](https://github.com/Jl4cTuk/morphe-patches/commit/0df233b05d66b3ab8912442af8d04a652bd400db))

### ✨ New Features

* disable RuStore and VK push services ([7c167b4](https://github.com/Jl4cTuk/morphe-patches/commit/7c167b4e664d16a5d89e294a8629807f60c44089))
* disable RuStore boot, network, and VPN hooks ([af11af7](https://github.com/Jl4cTuk/morphe-patches/commit/af11af7311daf62f47b1446d93e73a0cd7163307))
* disable RuStore SMS and call verification hooks ([7b3c193](https://github.com/Jl4cTuk/morphe-patches/commit/7b3c193227ffd99dcc108c1f279e915a2cea74b6))
* disable the RuStore gaming profile ([0144249](https://github.com/Jl4cTuk/morphe-patches/commit/0144249e0b2d10a7f866b9e6ad19841a710be60f))
* preserve RuStore secure sessions after re-signing ([67e64c6](https://github.com/Jl4cTuk/morphe-patches/commit/67e64c6156d36cc4b9c416873aedd23b1184a0d1))
* restrict invasive RuStore permissions ([98b5046](https://github.com/Jl4cTuk/morphe-patches/commit/98b5046984cdb87b6289b65a43b2d5f2458c0a9c))
* restrict RuStore background work to updates ([606b970](https://github.com/Jl4cTuk/morphe-patches/commit/606b970c20bea1349473ff1cc04c3037f5e0c2b1))
* skip RuStore update authentication prompts ([7f5e2be](https://github.com/Jl4cTuk/morphe-patches/commit/7f5e2be3c7f1fe1736e4e97c806f45cf5b294f7e))
* suppress Ozon tip notifications ([81a2107](https://github.com/Jl4cTuk/morphe-patches/commit/81a21072f2fb081210609d5797bb1489284b5ccc))

patches.name: Disable checkout tips
patches.description: Removes courier tips UI and prevents tip IDs or tip API calls from being submitted.

patches.name: Disable lottery and in-app pushes
patches.description: Disables lottery onboarding and the in-app push SDK used for reward popups.

patches.name: Disable telemetry
patches.description: Disables Ozon analytics, attribution, crash reporting, and telemetry uploads.

patches.name: Disable tip notifications
patches.description: Suppresses Ozon push notifications asking the user to leave a pickup-point tip.

patches.name: Hide Ozon Bank ad banner
patches.description: Removes the advertising banner carousel from the Ozon Bank screen.

patches.name: Hide account lottery and review feed
patches.description: Removes the lottery entry banner and review feed shortcut from the account screen.

patches.name: Hide seller rating prompt
patches.description: Removes the post-purchase seller rating prompt.

patches.name: Remove Ozon ads
patches.description: Removes Ozon ad widgets, checkout promotions, floating promotions, banner carousels, and PDP promo blocks.

options.description: Removes recommendation grids from product, cart, profile, and favorites screens.

patches.name: Show final prices only
patches.description: Hides crossed-out prices, discount percentages, and redundant price rows in the cart total.

patches.name: Disable Ozon Bank VPN warning
patches.description: Removes the warning shown when Ozon Bank detects an active VPN connection.

patches.name: Hide Ozon Bank benefit sections
patches.description: Adds options to hide selected non-advertising sections from the Benefit page.

options.description: Hides the Buy for 1 ruble product carousel.
Hides the For shopping on Ozon section.
Hides the Ozon Premium benefits section.

patches.name: Hide Ozon Bank promotions
patches.description: Uses the classic home design and removes promotional cards, sections, shortcuts, and the startup installment offer from Ozon Bank pages.

patches.name: Disable Mine redesign
patches.description: Reverts the Mine screen to the classic layout, disabling the redesigned V2/V3 interface.

patches.name: Disable ads
patches.description: Removes advertisements and search recommendations, clears advertising identifiers, keeps advertising consent disabled, and removes the unsolicited VK ID prompt, with options for additional interface cleanup.

options.description: Disables loyalty onboarding, points, notifications, links, and cashback banners.
Removes the Featured and Games tabs and opens Apps by default.
Removes notification buttons from the search bar and Mine screen.

patches.name: Disable analytics
patches.description: Disables analytics and tracking in RuStore.

patches.name: Disable background hooks
patches.description: Disables RuStore network-state monitoring, built-in VPN sessions, and startup hooks.

patches.name: Disable background scan
patches.description: Disables the periodic Kaspersky background device scan.

patches.name: Disable gaming profile
patches.description: Removes the Game Profile and usage statistics access, hides both gaming cards, and blocks navigation to the profile.

patches.name: Disable invasive permissions
patches.description: Removes privileged, phone, SMS, location, storage, billing, USB, and vendor access.

patches.name: Disable push services
patches.description: Disables RuStore and VK remote push services and background tasks.

patches.name: Exclude Google Play apps from updates
patches.description: Excludes Google Play installs from RuStore update checks while keeping RuStore and sideloaded apps.

patches.name: Restore secure-session compatibility
patches.description: Preserves RuStore secure-session requests when the APK is re-signed.

patches.name: Restrict background work to updates
patches.description: Keeps background workers required for update checks, downloads, patching, and installation.

patches.name: Skip update authentication
patches.description: Skips the VK ID authorization suggestion shown during app installs and updates.
